name: tollwire
description: TollWire adds a policy enforcement layer to AI coding agents: it checks file writes, shell commands and new dependencies before they run, blocks detected violations, and keeps a tamper-evident log of reported changes, scans and approvals that you can use as evidence in audits. The code runs locally.

plugins.name: tollwire-guardrail
plugins.description: Blocks recognized writes to protected paths, dangerous shell commands and non-allowlisted dependencies; exposes the same checks as MCP tools.

plugins.name: tollwire-evidence
plugins.description: Tamper-evident evidence log for reported agent changes, scans and approvals, with a draft ISO 27001 / NIS2 control mapping (not audited).
